insights:
Qwen cut the price of Qwen2.5 VL 72B Instruct from $0.867 to $0.417 per 1M tokens, a 52% drop and the day's headline move. That brings a large multimodal instruct model into a much cheaper band, though the changelog does not list an updated intelligence score for it. Elsewhere, two prices went up: Mistral Small 3.2 24B rose 25% to $0.146, and MiniMax M2.7 rose 8% to $0.540. No frontier ranking or intelligence-score changes were recorded.

A large batch of new model entries appeared, mostly catalog additions with no pricing or deal data: the Amazon Nova experimental chat series, several older Anthropic and OpenAI revisions, and assorted open-weight models. None carry intelligence or deal ratings. Separately, Qwen2.5 72B Instruct ($0.373) and Qwen2.5 Coder 32B Instruct ($0.773) were removed.
